name: DCA Shawarma Palace "New York's Tastiest" Chicken Shawarma Pita Wrap (Sauce on Side Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Shawarma Palace (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Warm flatbread pita filled with tender rotisserie-style chicken thighs; the yogurt-tahini dipping sauce is served in a separate cup on the side, though the chicken marinade contains garlic, warm spices, and a hint of lemon.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy the warm chicken and pita bread without the pickled red onions and keep the lemon-garlic coconut-yogurt tahini sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Contains garlic, cumin/coriander shawarma spice, and trace lemon in the marinade/dip (citrusFree: false)—skip during active flares
